execution_contract.implementation_rule: Use one generic data-driven second-case package builder. Repository-specific behavior may exist only in immutable input data and acceptance expectations, not conditional code paths.

fail_closed_conditions: missing required report section or package artifact
effective record count other than two
withheld claim count other than three
positive runtime, transcription-accuracy, or production-readiness claim
failure_and_rollback.rollback_effect: Freeze the second-case plan or generated package while preserving the accepted first package, source reviews, plan selection, and all prior records.

human_authorization.instruction: じゃあ、えっと最後の一文で、小人め候補の中から、検証価値の高い意見から、内容再現テストを進めてください。

identity.name: Evidence Report Second-Case Internal Operational Reproduction

input_contract.drift_policy: Any repository identity, source report, round, README blob, PR set, candidate count, or withheld-topic drift stops the run and requires a new human plan decision.
required: accepted first-case package decision and checkpoint
fixed read-only source report and round-review fingerprints

prohibited_positive_claims: external user value or commercial effectiveness is established

purpose: Test whether the accepted evidence-report workflow can reproduce a complete internal package on a sparse frozen public repository without promoting scaffold or documentation evidence into unverified runtime capability.

terminal.next_action: A human reviews this plan and decides whether to authorize one repository-local second-case operational validation build.

validation_hypotheses.failure_signal: Case-specific branching or duplicated package logic is required.
validation_hypotheses.statement: The same generic package workflow can process a second case without copying the first case implementation or adding repository-name conditionals.

validation_hypotheses.failure_signal: Any withheld topic disappears or is promoted to a positive capability claim.
validation_hypotheses.statement: Two bounded scaffold or process records remain effective achievements while three unsupported runtime topics remain withheld.

validation_hypotheses.failure_signal: Missing sections, placeholder removal, or incomplete artifacts.
validation_hypotheses.statement: A sparse evidence set still produces all nine report sections and all required package artifacts.

validation_hypotheses.failure_signal: Any pre-decision artifact fingerprint changes across two builds.
validation_hypotheses.statement: Identical accepted inputs reproduce identical JSON, Markdown, inventory, comparison, packet, verification, index, and summary fingerprints.

validation_hypotheses.failure_signal: Any consequential authority or action becomes true.
validation_hypotheses.statement: The second-case result remains internal and does not widen pricing, outreach, contracting, delivery, publication, customer-intake, external-execution, or source-write authority.
